Definition: Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah is the name of eight or nine Israelites, and the prophet who bore it has his own book. In 2 Kings 23:31, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah. The fuller story is told on the Jeremiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jeremiah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
